app.title: 悠长的假期
app.subtitle: A holiday with no to-do list
app.tagline: A quiet Alpine yard. Feed grass, walk the llama, or do nothing. Expressions arrive on their own.
menu.hint:
WASD, or click the grass: walk there
Space: pick grass / feed / lead
Esc: pause
There is no failure.
hud.hint: Walk on the grass. Farther away, you are smaller. The grass bundle is by the path.
pause.title: A pause
confirm.heading: Leave for now?
confirm.restart: The yard will wake again. Polaroids stay in the journal.
confirm.title: The holiday waits behind the door.
album.title: Polaroid journal
notice.arrive: The wind is light. You leave the bag by the door.
notice.picked_grass: A bundle of grass in your hand.
notice.fed_llama: It sniffs, and does not leave at once.
notice.lead_start: The llama follows you across the grass.
notice.lead_stop: The lead drops. It returns to its own day.
photo.llama_annoyed.title: Overcast annoyance
photo.llama_annoyed.note: When the goose comes close, the ears go first.
photo.llama_happy.title: A real smile in the sun
photo.llama_happy.note: A sheep approaches and the ears go soft.
photo.llama_smirk.title: Off the clock
photo.llama_smirk.note: Cow and horse finally have nothing to do but graze. The llama gives them a sideways grin: 'Even you two get a holiday.'
photo.llama_fed.title: After the right grass
photo.llama_fed.note: A short gentleness, then ordinary again.
photo.duck.title: Pond chorus
photo.duck.note: The ducks do not explain. They drift.
photo.cow.title: The cow, once
photo.cow.note: It almost never performs. That is why this one is quiet.
tuning.title: Holiday tuning
tuning.subtitle: These knobs change pace, never chores.
tuning.gameplay.expression_cooldown.desc: How long before the same face can return.
tuning.player.lead.description: Slower still while walking the llama.
tuning.enemies.goose.description: On gray days the goose enters other spaces more.
tuning.environment.zoom.description: A slight push of the fixed panorama.
tuning.local_failed: Could not save; changes stay in this preview.
tuning.local_ready: Changes save as a local preview draft.
